about: Hand-traced crack centre lines on the real dev photos. Points are [x, y] as fractions of image width and height, traced by eye on a 10x10 grid (0.05 grid for zoomed crops), so they are good to roughly 1-2% of the frame, not to the pixel. expected_px is the crack width in full-resolution pixels, estimated by eye; it stands in for the operator's expected_width_mm. 'networks' are regions of map cracking too dense to trace one by one: a detection inside counts as a hit on the network, not as a false component. 'no_crack_reason' marks images with nothing measurable.

commons/boyana-cracked-concrete.jpg.notes: Lower crack is the clear one; upper stub runs behind the plant.

commons/downtowngal-concrete-rebar.jpg.no_crack_reason: Demolition rubble: gaps between loose slabs, rebar and leaf litter. Nothing a width reading applies to; every component is false.

commons/fhwa-asr-barrier-2006.jpg.notes: ASR map cracking over the whole barrier face, 480x360 px. The vertical construction joint near x=0.85 is not a crack but lies inside the network region.

commons/harvey-concrete-cracked.jpg.notes: Exposed-aggregate slab; bright stones everywhere. Third crack (top) is faint.

commons/medway-retaining-wall.jpg.notes: Brick wall; mortar joints and coping shadows are dark, straight and not cracks.

commons/medway-vertical-crack-detail.jpg.notes: Gap between wall and step above y=0.37 is a joint, not labelled.

commons/nara-bridge-pier-crack-1936.jpg.notes: 1936 archival print. Board-formwork lines run across the whole face and look like cracks; label is uncertain.

commons/prygpt-hairline-cracks.jpg.no_crack_reason: Crazing drawn in light lines on a darker surface. A dark-crack detector has nothing to find; anything it returns is false.

commons/richfield-wall-9058.jpg.no_crack_reason: Whole cladding wall from a distance. Panel joints, drip stains and small spalls; no crack resolvable at this range.

commons/richfield-wall-9061.jpg.notes: Hairlines on cladding around a rust spall. Panel joints (grey mortar lines) and rust staining are not cracks.

mendeley-ozgenel/negative-00001.jpg.no_crack_reason: Dataset negative: plain concrete with one small pit.
